_comment: Scene A, as written by the owner. Edit the text here; the scene reads it by id. 'style': quiet = said to himself (smaller, dimmer subtitle, softer voice).

door_1.speaker: kurt
door_1.text: Ms. Sokolov? Your sister asked me to come check on you.

door_2.speaker: kurt
door_2.text: Marta? It's Kurt. I'm coming in.

boxes.speaker: marta
boxes.text: Little boxes made of boxes with boxes inside of them... Have you seen them? The boxes, I mean. They're scary at first. But then you look at them for a moment

little_bird.speaker: marta
little_bird.text: Look at the boxes, my little bird. Do you see them?

hey_buddy.speaker: socko
hey_buddy.text: Heyyyy buddyyyy.... You should probably take it slow, a concussion is no joke!

who_are_you.speaker: kurt
who_are_you.text: Yeah, you. Who the fuck are you?

im_socko.speaker: socko
im_socko.text: I'm Socko! I'm a handy little pal! Who are you?

too_fast.speaker: socko
too_fast.text: Shouldn't have stood up so fast.

thanks.speaker: kurt
thanks.text: Wow, thanks. I never would have guessed.
